name: @gebeta/maps-react-native
description: React Native SDK for Gebeta Maps

scripts.lint: test -d src && eslint "src/**/*.{ts,tsx}" || echo 'No src directory - skipping lint'
scripts.lint:fix: test -d src && eslint "src/**/*.{ts,tsx}" --fix || echo 'No src directory - skipping lint'
scripts.typecheck: test -d src && tsc --noEmit || echo 'No src directory - skipping typecheck'
scripts.format: test -d src && prettier --write "src/**/*.{ts,tsx}" || echo 'No src directory - skipping format'
scripts.format:check: test -d src && prettier --check "src/**/*.{ts,tsx}" || echo 'No src directory - skipping format check'
